title: Understanding the Benefits of Scaffolds through Computational Separations
abstract: arXiv:2610.27157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Inference-time harnesses, i.e., external procedures that call a model many times and keep state across calls, can substantially improve model capabilities. In this paper, we investigate the benefits of using such harnesses and the extent to which these benefits can be internalized through training. More precisely, we conceptualize a harness $\mathcal{A}$ as an arbitrary wrapper around a base model $M$ and attempt to distill a student model from the harness's traces. Empirically we find that, even with simple scaffolds and small models, the inference-time harness significantly outperforms a distilled student. We then prove that such a gap is due to a fundamental representational limitation: inference-time harnesses can compute a closure of their per-call primitive that is $\NL$-complete even when the primitive is a trivial $\AC^0$ lookup, and that no fixed-depth forward pass can represent under the widely believed conjecture that $\NL\n

translated_title: 通过计算复杂性分离理解脚手架的益处
translated_abstract: 推理时框架，即多次调用模型并在各次调用之间保持状态的外部程序，能够显著提升模型能力。本文研究了使用此类框架的益处，以及这些益处在多大程度上可以通过训练被内化。更准确地说，我们将框架 $\mathcal{A}$ 概念化为围绕基础模型 $M$ 的任意包装器，并尝试从框架的运行轨迹中蒸馏出一个学生模型。实验上我们发现，即使使用简单的脚手架和较小的模型，推理时框架也显著优于蒸馏得到的学生模型。随后我们证明，这一差距源于一个根本性的表达能力限制：即使每次调用的原语只是平凡的 $\AC^0$ 查找，推理时框架也能够计算出 $\NL$-完全的闭包；而在被广泛相信的猜想（关于 $\NL$ 与固定深度电路的关系）下，任何固定深度的前向传播都无法表示这样的计算。
tldr: 本文证明推理时脚手架即使基于平凡的 $\AC^0$ 原语，也能通过多次调用完成 $\NL$-完全的闭包计算，而固定深度的前向传播在标准复杂性猜想下无法表示该计算，从而解释了为何脚手架带来的能力提升无法通过蒸馏完全内化到模型之中。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that inference-time scaffolds can compute NL-complete closures even from trivial AC^0 primitives, a computation that no fixed-depth forward pass can represent under a widely believed complexity conjecture, explaining why scaffolding benefits cannot be fully internalized through distillation.
